method: All 38 unchanged original PNG files were opened directly with view_image and visually inspected; no resized contact sheet, simulated screenshot, rerun or source change was used. PNG dimensions and SHA256 were independently read from the exact files.
limitations: This review covers only the captured native CI stages and dimensions, not every settings/help page or a complete playthrough.
Screenshots alone do not verify timing, input cancellation, gameplay correctness or persistence; use the corresponding original runtime reports for those claims.

Android CI emulator screenshots are 1920x1080; Mac Intel images are 1280x720, ARM native/Rosetta images 1024x642, and ARM occupied-port images 1024x645. These are actual PNG dimensions, not substituted target viewport sizes.
No physical television, phone, ESP32 controller or physical Mac display was tested by this review.
